summary: FIR quashing appeal under CrPC s.482; allegations of rape (IPC s.376(2)(n)) and criminal intimidation (IPC s.506); inconsistent timelines in complaint (FIR vs MLC report vs sec 164 CrPC statement); consensual relationship evidenced by prolonged association, mutual meetings at various locations, and marriage plans; post-marriage FIR filing suggesting ulterior motive; Bhajan Lal parameters applied for quashing; no prima facie case established due to voluntary continuation of relationship and voluntary disclosure of address.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Haryana vs. Bhajan Lal
final_judgment: FIR quashed; impugned High Court order set aside; criminal proceedings quashed.
